description: Vulnerability in the WebCenter Content: Imaging product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Core).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via SOAP to compromise WebCenter Content: Imaging.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read access to a subset of WebCenter Content: Imaging accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.3 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N).
